values.note: Book on MyCountyParks at least 3 days ahead (sites show gray online 1-3 days out); on arrival any unoccupied site without a reservation slip on the post can be registered for that day. Reservations are non-refundable and dates can't be changed. Check-in and check-out 3 pm.

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Clayton/Park/Big-Spring-Campground/Facility/Big-Spring-Campground-Campsite-1/Availability ('ONLINE RESERVATIONS MUST BE MADE AT LEAST 3 DAYS IN ADVANCE.'; 'Upon arrival, any unoccupied sites without a reservation slip on the post, are available for day-of registration.'; '**Weekends require a 2 night minimum stay** **Holidays require a 3 night minimum stay**'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Clayton County: primitive sites $15 a night; a $4 processing fee on online reservations, non-refundable. Read 2026-11-03.

fees.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Clayton/Park/Big-Spring-Campground/Facility/Big-Spring-Campground-Campsite-1/Availability ('Fees $15/night'; 'All reservations with the Clayton County Conservation Board and the $4 Processing Fee is NON-REFUNDABLE') + park page ('Primitive camping is $15 per night'), read 2026-11-03

note: Clayton County Conservation primitive campground on the Turkey River, about 10 mi NW of Elkader, by the DNR's Big Spring Trout Hatchery and its trout and kids' fishing ponds. One RV or trailer per site; no pad length posted. Sites can close temporarily when the river is at flood stage. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: $15 primitive, one RV/trailer per site, 7 site listings, riverfront on the Turkey. Booking refined: 3-day online cutoff then day-of registration, weekend 2-night and holiday 3-night minimums; $4 processing fee added. No season or pad length published.
flags: WATERFRONT OK (riverfront): the county says 'This site is located along the Turkey River' on each site page; on Esri imagery the campground lane runs about 25-30 m north of the bank, with the sites between the lane and the river and a camper parked about 10 m from the bank at the east end; no road between. The Turkey is about 35-45 m wide here, above the ~30 m line.
FIT UNCLEAR, keep: sites allow 'one RV or one trailer'; no pad length is posted. The sites sit in trees on a short gravel lane.

SEASON (not changed): no season is published; the stored year_round (derived from the note) isn't contradicted, but nothing states it either. The park page gives only 'All county parks close at 10:30PM' and flood-stage closures.
SITE COUNT: the park text says 'six sites' but seven campsite listings (1-7) are bookable; stored 7 kept.
PIN (about 100 m off, under the 250 m bar): 42.91350,-91.48250 sits in the open field north of the campground; the campground lane is at about 42.91262,-91.48234.
PHONE OK: 563-245-1516 is the county office number on the cancellation policy.
